This notebook is showcasing how to code the collatz-conjecture in both Python and R

```{python}
def py_collatz(x):
  l = [x]
  #Create a list with the original value
  while x > 1:
    #Repeat till we reach a value of 1
    if (x%2 == 0):
      x = x/2
      x=int(x)
      l.append(x)
      #If our value is even, divide by 2 and added it to the list
    else:
      x *= 3
      x += 1
      x=int(x)
      l.append(x)
      #If our value is odd then multiply by 3, then add 1, then add to the list
  return(l)
```

```{r}
rcollatz <- function(x){
  l <- c(x)
  #Create a vector with our original value
  while(x>1){
    #Repeat till we reach a value of 1
    if(x%%2 == 0){
      x <- x/2
      l <- append(l,x)
      #If our valye is even, divide by 2 then add to the vector
    }else{
      x <- x*3
      x <- x+1
      l <- append(l,x)
      #If our value is odd then multiple by 3, then add 1, then add to the vector
    }
  }
  print(l)
}
```
